description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Ardent Elementalist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding {B}.
Ardent Elementalist triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
